claims: American Idol 2026 voting for the Top 20 is open until 6 a.m. ET on Tuesday, March 24.
American Idol 2026 voting has three ways: online at AmericanIdol.com/vote, text, and social media.
Up to 10 votes can be cast per contestant per method (online, text, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok) for American Idol 2026.
The Top 14 will be revealed in the March 30 episode.
Online voting for American Idol is at americanidol.com/vote.
Text voting for American Idol is by texting the contestant's assigned number to 21523.
Social media voting for American Idol uses the Official Vote Post on the official American Idol Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok accounts where the contestant's name is commented.
American Idol voting limits are 10 votes per contestant per method.
American Idol voting eligibility requires being 16+ and located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
American Idol voting generally closes at 6 a.m. ET the morning after performances.
The American Idol app is no longer used for voting.
Voting information is based on the American Idol 2026 season as of March 23, 2026.
